QUOTE: Two server errors are exceptions: `DELETED_ROOT_POST_ERROR`, `TOWN_SQUARE_READ_ONLY_ERROR` and `PLUGIN_DISMISSED_POST_ERROR` cause `removePost`, which deletes the post.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names all three server errors (deleted root post, read-only town square, plugin-dismissed post) as the cases where the failed post is removed rather than kept.
